shared_insertions.added_text: **本会话方向 / Session focus，2026-10-08。** [局部对齐与集体破坏性吸引子](theories/meta-attractor/COLLECTIVE-DESTRUCTIVE-ATTRACTORS.md)承接 Ren 的新问题：精确局部目标执行何时经相互作用与选择进入共同损失。第一构造有32项 Lean 定理／41项审计，给出阶段收益冲突、任意正吞吐下的有限到达、精确盆地、平局失败和严格保护。/ This first conditional result distinguishes objective fidelity from joint protection; [integration and author counterreview](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/COLLECTIVE-DESTRUCTION-INTEGRATION.md) retain supplied dynamics and the next connection: actual allocation/replacement and protection under endogenous selection. General population dynamics and empirical correspondence remain open; other sessions keep their scope.

**局部对齐与共同破坏 / Local alignment and collective destruction，2026-10-08。** [本会话研究](COLLECTIVE-DESTRUCTIVE-ATTRACTORS.md)给出精确局部最优化与共同损失相容的条件，并连接制度侵蚀、能力吞吐与有限吸引。32项新 Lean 定理／41项审计通过；严格保护与平局反例同时保留。/ The first conditional two-agent result establishes finite attraction and prevention under supplied laws. Actual population allocation/replacement and protection under endogenous selection are the next connection; carrier recurrence is not silently inherited.

**局部对齐与集体破坏性吸引子 / Local alignment and collective destruction，2026-10-08。** [研究与作者反审](COLLECTIVE-DESTRUCTION-INTEGRATION.md)完成第一条件见证：32项 Lean 定理／41项审计连接局部阶段最优化、共同损失、制度侵蚀、正吞吐下的有限吸引及严格保护。/ Continue the newly scoped population question through actual allocation, replacement and correction under endogenous selection; no independent acceptance or empirical validation is claimed.

**Collective alignment session, 8 October 2026.** [Ren’s exact question](15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-collective-destructive-attractors.md) scopes this session to destructive collective attractors despite local alignment. The [supplied problem list](collective-alignment/2026-10-08-open-problems-pasted-original.txt) is preserved byte for byte with [SHA-256 provenance](collective-alignment/PROVENANCE.json); its underlying author and ranking are not attributed to Ren or treated as consensus. The [focused primary comparison](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/COLLECTIVE-DESTRUCTION-INTEGRATION.md#primary-sources-and-their-scope) is link-only.

**局部对齐与共同破坏 / Local alignment and collective destruction，2026-10-08。** M24 成对追加[第一构造与作者反审](COLLECTIVE-DESTRUCTION-INTEGRATION.md)：32项新 Lean 定理／41项审计，局部目标忠实、有限吸引、平局失败及严格保护分别明示。/ Only the owned M24 suffixes, new evidence links and actually read new source hashes change. Existing results and unrelated rows are preserved. [Owned edits](COLLECTIVE-DESTRUCTION-INDEX-EDITS.json) and [scoped checks](COLLECTIVE-DESTRUCTION-CHECKS.json) do not certify concurrently changed sources; full-table review remains separate.

old_M24.scope_zh: 条件构造有47项新 Lean 定理／65项声明审计，直接连接实际核心轨迹、承载者替换、供给失败、盆地、扰动及区间／延迟下的退出。另有1,681项市场及1,053项回返预算计算。相同被动轨迹不足以辨认回返来源；经验对应、更丰富承载者实现及真实干预仍开放。作者反审不冒充独立验收；目标继续。
old_M24.scope_en: 47 new Lean theorems / 65 audits connect actual core traces, carrier replacement, supply failure, basin, disturbances and exit under delay/interval uncertainty. 1,681 market and 1,053 recurrence-budget calculations supplement the proofs. Identical passive histories need not identify causal return; empirical correspondence, richer carrier realization and actual interventions remain open. Author counterreview is not independent acceptance; the goal continues.
